work.text: He is also known for owning and appreciating an unstrung guqin, claiming that he did not need to bother with the sounds of the strings to value the instrument; this became a common literary reference, and also appears in later depictions of Tao such as his portrait by Chen Hongshou.

moment.text: From the Tang dynasty onward, he was closely associated with the practice of farming as a recluse.

matters.text: Poet Tao Yuanming (365–427 CE) turned down a career as an official in politically turbulent times to return to his home estate, northwest of Mount Lu, to write poetry and enjoy his garden and wine.
